items.markdown:
A salmon sperm facial (technically known as a **polynucleotide** or **PDRN** treatment) `uses highly purified DNA fragments extracted from salmon or trout sperm to regenerate skin cells and stimulate collagen and elastin production`.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/salmon-sperm-facial)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C4zqkmdQkw4)[[3]](https://www.everydayhealth.com/skin-care/what-is-a-salmon-sperm-facial/)

### How It Works

- **Purified DNA:** The actual sperm cells are not used; instead, scientists extract, ultra-filtrate, and purify the DNA in a lab, removing all proteins and hormones.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=15YVwcdLj-I&t=93)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/cnninternational/videos/salmon-sperm-facials-have-been-popularized-on-social-media-in-recent-years-but-h/816286211190484/)[[3]](https://www.injectual.com/blogs/news/do-salmon-sperm-injections-work)
- **Cellular Repair:** Salmon DNA closely resembles human DNA, making it highly biocompatible. When injected or microneedled into the dermis, it acts as a "jumpstart" for fibroblast cells to repair tissue and boost hydration.[[1]](https://www.efmedispa.com/insights/salmon-sperm-facial-explained)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/cnninternational/videos/salmon-sperm-facials-have-been-popularized-on-social-media-in-recent-years-but-h/816286211190484/)[[3]](https://www.healthline.com/health/salmon-sperm-facial)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/rSPQS2CCuto)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C4zqkmdQkw4)
- **Not a Filler:** Unlike traditional dermal fillers, polynucleotides do not add physical volume or change facial contours; they focus on skin quality, elasticity, and smoothing fine lines.[[1]](https://www.bbc.com/future/article/20260327-the-bizarre-skincare-rituals-that-might-actually-work)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C4zqkmdQkw4)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/-1NcP0-6rPo)

### Treatment & Safety

- **Application:** Delivered via micro-injections or topical application combined with microneedling, usually taking 20 to 30 minutes (often with a numbing cream).[[1]](https://www.drleah.co.uk/blog/post/what-is-a-salmon-sperm-facial)[[2]](https://www.healthline.com/health/salmon-sperm-facial)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/vcrrEXFhSuA)
- **Cost & Regimen:** Typically requires an initial course of 2 to 3 sessions per year, costing roughly $300 to $400 per session depending on the clinic and location.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=15YVwcdLj-I&t=93)
- **Regulation:** The treatment originated in South Korea and is widely available in Europe and parts of Asia, but it is **not FDA-approved** in the United States.[[1]](https://www.everydayhealth.com/skin-care/what-is-a-salmon-sperm-facial/)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/cnninternational/videos/salmon-sperm-facials-have-been-popularized-on-social-media-in-recent-years-but-h/816286211190484/)[[3]](https://www.healthline.com/health/salmon-sperm-facial)
- **Side Effects & Cautions:** Downtime is minimal, limited to mild redness, swelling, or small bumps that resolve within 12 to 24 hours. It is contraindicated for people with severe fish/seafood allergies, autoimmune conditions, or those who are pregnant or breastfeeding.[[1]](https://theaestheticstandard.co.uk/polynucleotides/salmon-sperm-injections/)[[2]](https://www.drleah.co.uk/blog/post/what-is-a-salmon-sperm-facial)

More details can be explored through coverage on [BBC Future](https://www.bbc.com/future/article/20260327-the-bizarre-skincare-rituals-that-might-actually-work) or [Everyday Health](https://www.everydayhealth.com/skin-care/what-is-a-salmon-sperm-facial/).[[1]](https://www.bbc.com/future/article/20260327-the-bizarre-skincare-rituals-that-might-actually-work)[[2]](https://www.everydayhealth.com/skin-care/what-is-a-salmon-sperm-facial/)Are you looking into this treatment for **specific skin concerns like anti-aging or scarring** , or would you like to know more about **availability and practitioners in your area**?
